stories.title: Espace : les États-Unis confirment pour la première fois avoir déployé des armes en orbite

en.title: Space: the United States confirms for the first time having deployed weapons in orbit
en.summary: The US Space Force announced it possesses armed space control systems designed to protect American forces against hostile actions. The deployment is justified by increasing military capabilities from China and Russia in space.

stories.title: L'administration Trump abroge les limites d'émissions polluantes imposées aux centrales électriques

en.title: Trump administration repeals pollution emission limits imposed on power plants
en.summary: The Trump administration has revoked emissions restrictions on electrical power plants. The energy sector accounts for approximately one-quarter of United States greenhouse gas emissions.

stories.title: L'Ukraine se dit prête à des "mesures de désescalade" si la Russie fait de même

en.title: Ukraine says it is ready for "de-escalation measures" if Russia does the same
en.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky indicated Monday the possibility of reducing tensions in the war against Russian invasion, without confirming Trump's claim that Kyiv and Moscow agreed to halt strikes on energy infrastructure.

stories.title: États-Unis : un juge bloque une mesure de Trump limitant la durée de séjour des étudiants et journalistes étrangers

en.title: United States: a judge blocks a Trump measure limiting the length of stay for foreign students and journalists
en.summary: A federal judge blocked a new rule from the Department of Homeland Security that would restrict how long foreign students and journalists can remain in the country. The decision came just before the measure was set to take effect.

stories.title: Déploiements, exercices, forces aériennes… Qu’est-ce que la dissuasion nucléaire «avancée» proposée par Emmanuel Macron aux pays européens ?

en.title: Deployments, exercises, air forces… What is the 'advanced' nuclear deterrence proposed by Emmanuel Macron to European countries?
en.summary: Emmanuel Macron has proposed extending French nuclear deterrence capabilities to European allies through potential temporary deployments of French nuclear forces outside France.

stories.title: Des fausses vidéos pour illustrer les frappes houthis en Arabie Saoudite

en.title: False videos used to illustrate Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Fabricated videos have circulated depicting Houthi rebel attacks against Saudi forces and damage from strikes on Saudi oil installations during the ongoing Houthi offensive.

stories.title: Les États-Unis reconnaissent pour la première fois avoir déployé des armes dans l’espace

en.title: The United States acknowledges for the first time having deployed weapons in space
en.summary: The US Space Force confirmed that the United States possesses armed systems deployed in orbit that can be used for offensive and defensive purposes.

stories.title: Des «mesures de désescalade» seront prises par l’Ukraine si la Russie fait de même, affirme Zelensky

en.title: Ukraine will implement "de-escalation measures" if Russia does the same, Zelensky states
en.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky has made any reduction in Ukraine's military effort conditional on Russian de-escalation commitments secured through American intermediaries.

stories.title: Donald Trump affirme que l'Ukraine et la Russie ont accepté d'arrêter les bombardements sur les infrastructures énergétiques adverses

en.title: Donald Trump says Ukraine and Russia have agreed to stop bombing each other's energy infrastructure
en.summary: The U.S. president called on Ukrainian President Zelensky to cease attacking Russian oil refineries, citing concerns about rising fuel prices. Trump claims both nations have now agreed to halt such bombardments.

stories.title: États-Unis : Donald Trump refuse de ralentir dans la course à l'IA

en.title: United States: Donald Trump refuses to slow down in the AI race
en.summary: Trump criticized calls for stricter regulation of artificial intelligence on Monday, describing concerns about AI as a conspiracy. Growing worries persist about the rapid development of AI and its potential impact on humanity.

stories.title: Face aux menaces des Houthis, l’Arabie Saoudite inquiète et isolée

en.title: Facing Houthi threats, Saudi Arabia worried and isolated
en.summary: Saudi Arabia, the world's top oil exporter, is seeking international support as it confronts attacks from Yemeni rebels in the Bab el-Mandeb strait. The kingdom finds itself abandoned by its traditional ally, Donald Trump.

stories.title: Guerre en Ukraine : la frappe contre un train démontre "la fébrilité de Vladimir Poutine dans un moment où la Russie va très mal", estime le chef de la diplomatie française

en.title: War in Ukraine: Strike against a train demonstrates "Vladimir Putin's nervousness at a time when Russia is faring very poorly," according to French foreign affairs chief
en.summary: France's foreign minister stated that recent Russian attacks on Ukraine aim to intimidate Europeans and reflect instability in Russia's position.

stories.title: Spatial : ArcSpace s'installe à Toulouse pour sa soudeuse qui répare les satellites en orbite

en.title: Space: ArcSpace establishes itself in Toulouse for its welder that repairs satellites in orbit
en.summary: ArcSpace, developing a welding device weighing under 2 kilograms designed to repair satellites in space, is establishing operations in Toulouse to accelerate the deployment of in-orbit services.

stories.title: Gaz : à 1 000 mètres sous terre, la course au remplissage des réserves françaises

en.title: Gas: 1,000 meters underground, the race to fill French reserves
en.summary: France's concerns about potential year-end gas shortages are diminishing. Storage facilities in Chémery have reached 80 percent capacity, securing the nation's gas supply.

stories.title: Sentinel 3C et FLEX : deux satellites européens pour mieux comprendre le dérèglement climatique

en.title: Sentinel 3C and FLEX: two European satellites to better understand climate disruption
en.summary: A Vega C launcher is scheduled to deploy two Earth observation satellites, Sentinel 3C and FLEX, into orbit in mid-September for the EU's Copernicus program and the European Space Agency. These satellites will enable detailed study of climate and vegetation.

stories.title: Portrait : Adrien Facon, nouveau directeur de l’Agence de l’innovation de défense

en.title: Portrait: Adrien Facon, new director of the Defense Innovation Agency
en.summary: Adrien Facon has been appointed as the new director of France's defense innovation agency, with quantum technology as a focus area.

stories.title: Retraites, donations, impôt sur le revenu… Ce que l’on sait déjà du budget 2027

en.title: Pensions, donations, income tax… What is already known about the 2027 budget
en.summary: The government is considering measures to reduce the deficit, including asking retirees to contribute more through pension adjustments and tax allowance changes. Plans also include income tax bracket indexation and temporary facilitation of family donations.
